description: Na₅Al(PO₄)₂F₂ crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3 space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to three equivalent O and three equivalent F atoms to form NaO₃F₃ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent AlO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with three equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 28°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.36 Å. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.40 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O and three equivalent F atoms. There are three shorter (2.38 Å) and three longer (2.84 Å) Na-O bond lengths. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.36 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.61 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.39 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form NaO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₃F₃ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent AlO₄F₂ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.33 Å) and two longer (2.43 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.47 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.52 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.47 Å. Al is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form AlO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₃F₃ octahedra, corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 28°. There are two shorter (1.90 Å) and two longer (1.92 Å) Al-O bond lengths. Both Al-F bond lengths are 1.85 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with five NaO₃F₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 31-68°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Al, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂AlP trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Al, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Al atom.
